title: UK, EU & US Sanctions, VAT, Registry, RDAP/DNS Security, Recall & MCP Trust Input

action.title: Screening Action
action.description: Select the full unified compliance screen or an individual deterministic check.

entity_name.title: Entity / Individual / Product Name
entity_name.description: Organization, company, charity, person, or product name to screen.

domain.title: Domain Name (for RDAP, Email & DNS Security Posture)
domain.description: Optional domain to audit RDAP, MX, SPF, DMARC, and CAA records over Cloudflare/Google DNS-over-HTTPS.

domains.title: Batch Domains List (for bulk_email_and_domain_hygiene)
domains.description: Optional list of up to 100 domains for batch DNS/DMARC hygiene screening (charged_results_only=True).

input_schema_json.title: Apify .actor/input_schema.json Payload (for lint_apify_mcp_input_schema)
input_schema_json.description: Optional JSON string of an Apify .actor/input_schema.json file to lint and auto-fix for the MCP required+default silent drop bug.

company_or_charity_number.title: UK Charity or Companies House Number
company_or_charity_number.description: Optional UK Charity registration number (e.g. 202918) or UK Companies House number (e.g. 00612172).

vat_number.title: EU or UK VAT Number (e.g. IE6388047V or GB999999973)
vat_number.description: Optional EU Member State, Northern Ireland (XI), or UK (GB) VAT number to verify via EU VIES REST API / HMRC Modulo-97.

uk_postcode.title: UK Postcode (for ONS/OS Council & Parish Lookup)
uk_postcode.description: Optional UK postcode (e.g. SW1A 1AA or OX14 4AB) to resolve Local Authority Council, Civil Parish, Ward, and GSS codes.

include_rdap.title: Include Live RDAP Registration Metadata
include_rdap.description: Fetch live IANA/Nominet RDAP registration, expiration, status flags, and nameservers alongside DNS security checks.

include_us_ofac.title: Include US Treasury OFAC SDN Screen
include_us_ofac.description: Screen entity against the live US Treasury OFAC SDN list.

include_us_recalls.title: Include US FDA / CPSC / NHTSA Recall & Enforcement Screen
include_us_recalls.description: Screen entity/product against live US FDA openFDA, CPSC SaferProducts, and NHTSA recall APIs.

vehicle_make.title: Vehicle Make (Optional NHTSA Check)
vehicle_make.description: Optional vehicle manufacturer make for NHTSA recall lookup (e.g. Ford).

vehicle_model.title: Vehicle Model (Optional NHTSA Check)
vehicle_model.description: Optional vehicle model for NHTSA recall lookup (e.g. F-150).

vehicle_year.title: Vehicle Model Year (Optional NHTSA Check)
vehicle_year.description: Optional vehicle model year for NHTSA recall lookup (e.g. 2023).

max_results.title: Max Results Per Source
max_results.description: Maximum number of matched records to return per data source (clamped 1..50).
